analysis_md: 两边取对数 $\ln z=y^x\ln y$，两边关于 $y$ 求导，$\frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=xy^{x-1}\ln y+y^{x-1}$，则 $$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=y^{y^x}y^{x-1}(x\ln y+1)$$
